notes.title: Thank you for your support with Invisible X wishlists
notes.notes:
It’s amazing to see the growth of wishlists for Invisible X on Steam. We’ve already surpassed 250 additions and are continuing to move forward. This means so much to me and the future of the game.

If you haven’t done so yet, I invite you to add it to your wishlist. It’s a simple but powerful way to support this indie project and help more players discover it.

Thank you for being part of this journey. We’re still working hard to release a demo in 2025!
